description: The image displays two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), each representing proportional distributions of categories with distinct visual patterns and percentage labels. Chart (a) contains six segments, each with a unique pattern and percentage: a large blue-striped segment at 31%, a medium blue-striped segment at 21%, a green-dotted segment at 17%, a green-crosshatched segment at 15%, a yellow-hatched segment at 9%, and a light blue-striped segment at 7%. Chart (b) contains four segments: a large blue-striped segment at 38%, a pink-dot patterned segment at 27%, a yellow-hatched segment at 19%, and a gray-dot patterned segment at 15%. Both charts include legends that map the patterns to category labels—chart (a) links patterns to words like “the,” “this,” “for,” “chemical,” “to,” and “in,” while chart (b) links patterns to “the,” “$,” “equilibrium,” and “.” The percentages are clearly labeled within each segment, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded. The segments in both charts appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest.
